blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY—For the first time in its history, the Army’s 10th Infantry Division (10ID) brought a national military tradition to Davao de Oro to honor a retiring combat veteran. The division feted Brig. Gen. Apollo Jun Lamaton, commander of the 1002nd Infantry Brigade, with a testimonial parade at the division headquarters in Mawab
